_about: P2-13 common mutant set: injected MUST-defects on the surface BOTH suites target (REST checkout / order / discount / fulfillment / error-envelope / discovery body against the flower golden). Every mutant models a SERVER defect a conformant implementation would never emit, injected by sticky_proxy.py so both suites hit the SAME mutated server. `citations` name rows in conformance/requirements/2026-04-08/ (verbatim-quote-verified by verify_register.py); test_compare.py fails if a cited id is missing or is not a MUST/MUST NOT. `shared_surface: false` mutants target requirement surfaces the OFFICIAL suite does not attempt (e.g. HTTP response headers) — they are NEVER counted in the head-to-head; they feed the clearly-labeled 'surfaces only spck covers' addendum.

_excluded_by_design.candidate: grand total does not equal the sum of the other totals entries
_excluded_by_design.reason: NOT a business-side MUST in the pinned 2026-04-08 spec: totals-consistency verification is a platform MAY (TOT-008); the MUSTs on mismatched totals (TOT-010, CHK-055) bind the PLATFORM, not the server. A MUST-defect set must stay register-grounded, so it is excluded from the head-to-head rather than blended in. For transparency it is still MEASURED as the `tot-grand-total-off` diagnostic below (counted nowhere): the official suite catches it via its grand-total-formula verification; spck surfaces it as a TOT-008 advisory (totals.checkout_sum_consistency), which under the strict catch rule (MUST-deviation red) is deliberately NOT a catch.

Webhooks travel OUTBOUND from the golden to each suite's receiver, so a response-mutation proxy cannot inject the defect for both suites identically. Excluded from the injectable set for BOTH sides (the official suite now has webhook_structure_test on this surface; ours has webhook checks + the ucp#568 tripwire). No number is claimed either way.

No totals entry of type `total` in checkout responses

Subtotal totals entries carry NEGATIVE amounts (sign flipped)
Subtotal totals entries omit the required `amount` field
Error responses omit the `messages` array

Server returns HTTP 200 for every request it actually rejected (errors only signaled in the body)

Every fulfillment option omits the required `title`

mutants.surface_note: HTTP response-header surface: the official suite has no header assertions anywhere, so counting this against it would pad our number. Reported only in the spck-only addendum.

mutants.defect: Responses served with Content-Type text/html instead of application/json
Grand total is one minor unit higher than the sum of the other totals entries
mutants.surface_note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (see _excluded_by_design): TOT-008 makes totals-consistency verification a platform MAY, so this is not a server MUST-defect and is counted in neither the head-to-head nor the addendum. Measured because a skeptic deserves the outcome rather than a silent exclusion.
